comparator.sourceNotes: Current requirements close 60+60+60. The second-year 9-EC restricted choice uses Experimental Projects6, whose team/lecturer preparation is retained, plus semester-2 Fluid Phenomena3; Astro-Particle Physics is excluded because its expected preparation includes compulsory courses taught later in the same year. Year3 preserves genuine open30, separate Relativistic Electrodynamics3 and the 27-EC research project split20+3+1+3. Required current upper-year modules support normalized NLD+ENG.
